A layout table renders its rows as list items, and those markers honour the bullets option like any other list

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert, ConversionOptions

def main() -> None:
    html = '<table><tr><td>alpha</td><td>beta</td></tr><tr><td><a href="/1">a</a></td><td><a href="/2">b</a></td><td><a href="/3">c</a></td></tr></table>'
    options = ConversionOptions(bullets="*+-")
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
